stories.title: South Carolina's 60th Annual Governor's Carolighting set for November 22 at State House
stories.summary: Gov. Henry McMaster will lead his final Governor's Carolighting on November 22 as South Carolina celebrates the holiday tradition's 60th anniversary.

stories.title: South Carolina residents raise concerns over utility bills at Dominion-NextEra merger hearing
stories.summary: Residents in Columbia voiced concerns over a $66 billion merger between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy, fearing higher electric bills.

stories.title: South Carolina lawmakers weigh AI benefits, cybersecurity risks in state government
stories.summary: South Carolina has reviewed nearly 300 government AI use cases as lawmakers consider stronger safeguards and a $5.5 million cybersecurity request.

stories.title: Back-to-back tech disruptions raise questions about reliability
stories.summary: A string of unexpected outages is putting digital security, consumer confidence and holiday plans to the test.

stories.title: SC State freshman dies after coming into contact with live power line following crash
stories.summary: SC State freshman Quentavious Carter, 18, died after contacting a live power line following a crash in Aiken County, according to officials.

stories.title: Teacher of the Week: Shiniqua Mays continues five generations of educators
stories.summary: Newberry Middle School teacher Shiniqua Mays is News19's Teacher of the Week, continuing a family legacy of five generations in education.

stories.title: SLED: Suspect 'acted suspiciously' before shooting Lexington County deputy at gun show near Columbia
stories.summary: The suspect died in an exchange of gunfire. The deputy has had multiple surgeries.

stories.title: Richland Deputies: Suspect kills man two days after being released from federal prison
stories.summary: The killing happened shortly after a party to celebrate the suspect's release from federal prison.

stories.title: More than $10,000 in equipment stolen from Orangeburg public utilities department, police say
stories.summary: Investigators say one person is in custody and they're working to locate another person believed to be connected to the theft.

stories.title: Lt. Gov.-elect Mike Reichenbach resigns from South Carolina Senate ahead of new role
stories.summary: Mike Reichenbach will leave South Carolina Senate District 31 as he prepares to serve as lieutenant governor alongside Gov.-elect Alan Wilson.

stories.title: East Point Academy announces temporary closure after spike in student flu cases
stories.summary: East Point Academy will close November 17 and 18 after a surge in flu cases, with five classes reporting at least 20% of students absent due to illness.

stories.title: Batesburg-Leesville considers zoning changes as data center debate grows in South Carolina
stories.summary: Batesburg-Leesville leaders are exploring zoning changes for data centers as concerns grow over their potential impact on local communities.
